settings.title: AI sales agent
settings.intro: Your best salesperson, on WhatsApp all day: it answers every enquiry in seconds, understands the trip, recommends your packages with prices, handles objections, takes booking details and follows up at the right time. It flags your team when a lead is ready, learns from your chats every night, and scores every lead.
settings.notReady: The AI isn't set up on this server yet, so no suggestion can be made. Your platform's administrator adds the OpenRouter key.
settings.switchIntro: When it is on, a Suggest reply button appears in each chat for your staff, and the AI reads a lead's chat to guess how likely it is to book. The chat's last messages, the lead's trip details, your knowledge, trip details and quick replies, and the instructions below are sent to the AI service, which keeps nothing. First name only: never a phone number or email.
settings.on: Let the AI draft replies and guess how leads will go
settings.usage: {used} of {limit} AI calls used this month, by every AI feature.
settings.instructionsIntro: Your tone, your language, what you usually offer, and what it must never say. It also uses your trip details and quick replies.
settings.instructionsPlaceholder: Reply in Hinglish, warm and short. Always ask for the travel dates and the number of travellers. Never offer a discount.
settings.instructionsHint: Up to 4,000 characters. Anything it should always do or never say. Prices and packages go in what the AI knows, below. Don't write secrets here: your staff and the AI service read it.

lines.dates: Ask for the travel dates and the number of travellers early.
lines.pickup: Mention our free airport pickup with every package.
lines.twoOptions: Offer a 3-star and a 4-star option side by side.
lines.honeymoon: For honeymoon couples, suggest the candle-light dinner add-on.
lines.advance: To book, ask for a 30% advance by UPI.
lines.noDiscount: Never promise a discount; say the team will check.
lines.budget: If the budget is low, suggest fewer nights rather than a cheaper hotel.
lines.itinerary: Share the full itinerary once they give their dates.

settings.scoring: Let the AI score each lead
settings.scoringHint: After each message from a customer: its chance to book, a line on how the lead stands, the next step, and whether it looks fake. Shown on the lead's page.

suggest.nothing: The AI had no reply to suggest for this chat.
suggest.draftedHint: Read it, change it, then send.

knowledge.title: What the AI knows
knowledge.description: Your packages, prices, inclusions, dates, payment details and policies. The AI quotes only from these (and your trip details and quick replies), and tells your team when something isn't here.
knowledge.upload: Upload a PDF or text file
knowledge.uploaded: Uploaded. The AI is reading it.
knowledge.fileType: Choose a PDF or a .txt file.
knowledge.empty: Nothing yet. Add your packages and prices so the AI can answer about them.
knowledge.alsoKnown: Your trips' details and your quick replies are known too, without adding them here.
knowledge.removeDescription: The AI won't know it any more, and a document's file is deleted.
knowledge.dialogDescription: Write it as you would tell a new salesperson: the package, what's included, the price and its basis.
knowledge.bodyPlaceholder: Kerala 5N/6D: Munnar 2N, Thekkady 1N, Alleppey houseboat 1N, Kovalam 1N. ₹18,500 per person on twin sharing, hotels, breakfast, cab and sightseeing included. Flights extra.

insight.title: AI's guess
insight.info: The AI's reading of this lead from its chat: how likely it books in the next two weeks, why, and what to do next. A guess to help you choose who to call first, never a decision: it never changes the lead's stage.
insight.fakeHint: Spam, a test or a wrong number, by the AI's reading.

autopilot.title: Autopilot
autopilot.info: The AI answers WhatsApp chats by itself, as your sales agent. It is off until you turn it on here, and you can turn it off in any one chat. Every message it sends is marked "Sent by the AI" in the chat and kept in the audit log.
autopilot.intro: Let the AI answer your customers on WhatsApp by itself, and nudge those who go quiet.
autopilot.on: Let the AI answer WhatsApp chats by itself
autopilot.needsAi: Turn on "Use the AI" above first.
autopilot.rules: It writes only inside the 24 hours a customer opens by writing, never to someone who wrote STOP, never while one of your team is answering that chat, and within this month's AI calls. It quotes prices only from what it knows, never confirms a booking or a payment, and says it is an AI to anyone who asks. Your team can turn it off in any chat or take over at any time.
autopilot.speakIntro: The language, length, emojis and tone of its messages, and the name it signs as.

personas.natural: An everyday chat in the copied person's way

autopilot.sellTitle: When it steps back, and follow-ups
autopilot.sellIntro: When a person must take over, how many messages it may write in a chat a day, and when it writes again to a customer who went quiet.
autopilot.handoff: Handing a chat to a person

handoffs.alert: Never by itself: it flags your team and keeps helping
handoffs.asked: When the customer asks for a person or is upset
handoffs.careful: Also for bookings, payments and discounts

autopilot.maxReplies: Most messages in one chat a day
autopilot.followUpHours: Hours of silence before one follow-up
autopilot.smartFollowUp: Let the AI choose whether and when to follow up
autopilot.learning: Let the AI learn from your chats each night
autopilot.learningHint: Your recent chats, with numbers, emails and links taken out, go to the AI service, which keeps nothing, to find what customers ask and what wins a booking. Off by default.

learnings.title: What the AI has learned
learnings.intro: General lessons from your chats that the autopilot uses. Turn one off or dismiss it.
learnings.empty: Nothing learned yet. It looks at your recent chats each night.
learnings.learningOff: Learning is off. Turn it on in the autopilot settings above.

voice.title: A way of talking to copy
voice.intro: Pick one of your team's WhatsApp chat exports and who in it, and the AI writes the way that person writes. Only that person's own messages are read: what the other side wrote never leaves your browser.
voice.current: It copies {name}, from {count} of their messages.
voice.removed: The AI talks its own way again
voice.fileHint: In WhatsApp: open a chat, More, Export chat, Without media.
voice.unreadable: That file has no WhatsApp messages in it.
voice.whoHint: Choose your own team member, not the customer.
voice.chatIntro: Give the AI an export of this chat and choose whose way of talking to copy here: it reads both sides, so it also remembers what the two talked about, and it wins over the agency's way of talking in this chat. The whole chat's words go to the AI service.
voice.notAnExport: This file doesn't look like a WhatsApp chat export. Export it from WhatsApp, without media.
